scripts.check: npm run runtime:check && npm run typecheck && npm run build:client && npm run tooling:check && npm run test:unit
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --env dev

scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env staging

scripts.predev: npm run runtime:check && npm run build:client
scripts.tooling:check: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/client-source-check.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/check-js.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/image-budget-check.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/route-parity-check.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/architecture-check.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/docs-check.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/release-policy-check.ts

scripts.workers:build:staging: npm ci --ignore-scripts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/workers-build-preflight.ts staging && npm run check && npm run security:check
